action_summary: Local instant-knowledge tier for the Perfect Algorithm: a new offline, completeness-gated source (local_guide_v1) reads the computer's own guides (README, AGENTS.md, .md docs) BEFORE the web tier. A document answers only if one paragraph shares content tokens with the query (60% of content tokens, minimum 2); function words carry no conclusion. The web tier (jit_knowledge) is asked only when the caller passes allow_instant_knowledge=True and the local tier misses. The Perfect Algorithm loop now asks the local tier whenever the plan fails after the scan, always reports what it found, and never fabricates a plan from it. 23 perfect-algorithm tests + 8 local-guide tests + 35 environment-learning tests, 33/33 unified-model verify.
